svg.data-weight-note: 23.44 lb (10.63 kg) without power supplies and fans, 31.09 lb (14.1 kg) with them (Table 26)
svg.data-port-speeds: QSFP28 ports 0 to 63 run at 100 GbE by default and at 40 GbE with a QSFP+ transceiver. They run at 50, 25 or 10 GbE by channelization or breakout cable (up to 128 logical ports). The SFP+ ports run at 1 or 10 GbE
svg.data-power-input-ac: 90 to 264 VAC, 50 to 60 Hz, 12 A at 100 VAC or 6 A at 240 VAC
svg.data-power-input-dc: rated -48 to -60 VDC, operating range -40 to -72 VDC, 25 A maximum
svg.data-redundancy-note: two supplies, 2N, each carrying the whole load; one may be removed at a time while the switch runs
svg.data-fans: four fan modules and the fans in the two supplies; the switch runs 30 seconds without thermal shutdown while one fan module is replaced
svg.data-storage-temp: -40 to 70 C (-40 to 158 F) in the shipping container
svg.data-humidity: 5 to 90 percent noncondensing (up to 93 percent short term)
svg.data-altitude: AFO builds no performance degradation to 1828.8 m (6000 ft); AFI builds none at sea level
svg.data-optics-qsfp28: 100 GbE QSFP28 and 40 GbE QSFP+ transceivers. DAC and breakout cables (QSFP+ to SFP+ DACBO, QSFP28 to QSFP+ DACBO). High-wattage optics (above 3.5 W) only in ports 32 to 63 on the AFI builds (guide, QFX5210-64C Port Panel Overview and Table 25)
svg.data-optics-sfp-plus: 1 GbE or 10 GbE SFP+ transceivers (guide, QFX5210-64C Port Panel Overview)
svg.data-channelization: ports 0 to 31 take 4 x 10, 4 x 25 and 2 x 50 GbE breakouts. Ports 32 to 63 take 2 x 50 GbE before Junos OS 19.1R1. From 19.1R1 on, any port
svg.data-seismic: Designed to comply with Zone 4 earthquake requirements per GR-63, Issue 4

g.data-description: Table 13 - the status lamp is green at 1000 Mbps and amber at 100 Mbps, unlit at 10 Mbps or link down; the link activity lamp is green steady with a link and blinking with traffic
